name: The Beam and detector of the NA62 experiment at CERN

summary.plain: The technical paper describing how the NA62 experiment's beam and detector were built to catch a positive kaon decaying into a pion and two invisible particles.
summary.technical: JINST 12 (2017) P05025 (arXiv:1703.08501): describes the NA62 400 GeV/c SPS-derived kaon beam line and the full detector -- GigaTracker, RICH, calorimeters, straw trackers and veto systems -- constructed 2009-2014 and commissioned from 2014, with early performance from 2014-2015 data.
